purpose: Prep the meeting; teach 株主/各種/廃止/合理/要請/流通/中間/命令

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 株主総会が近い。準備を進めよう。
lines.en: The shareholders’ meeting is near. Let’s prep.
lines.style: commanding boss setting the agenda, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 各種の資料をまとめています。
lines.en: I’m compiling all kinds of materials.
lines.style: diligent assistant reporting progress, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 古い制度の廃止も提案しますか？
lines.en: Shall we propose abolishing the old system too?
lines.style: strategic manager raising an idea, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ああ、合理的に判断したい。
lines.en: Yes, I want to judge it rationally.
lines.style: decisive boss demanding logic, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 取引先からの要請も増えています。
lines.en: Requests from clients are increasing too.
lines.style: assistant flagging external pressure, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 商品の流通網も見直すべきですね。
lines.en: We should review the distribution network too.
lines.style: manager proposing a fix, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 中間管理職の負担も考慮しよう。
lines.en: Let’s consider middle managers’ burden too.
lines.style: thoughtful boss weighing people, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 上からの命令を、現場にどう伝えるかも課題です。
lines.en: How to convey top-down orders to the field is a challenge too.
lines.style: assistant raising a real concern, tone holding steady through the whole line
